title: Ops field guide: RBAC v2 identity-provider debug scripts, audit triage, and support macros
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operational field guide for on-call and support teams covering RBAC v2 admin controls, SSO/SAML IdP troubleshooting, and audit-log triage. Deliverables: runbook steps, ready-to-use support macros, and shell/snippet tools for quick diagnosis.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook contains step-by-step escalation for Admin access issues and RBAC misconfigurations
Support macros cover common customer scenarios with parameter placeholders
Troubleshooting snippets validate SAML metadata, assertion contents, and session mapping
Audit search queries identify who changed a role, when, and previous role state
Team review and sign-off from Security and Support leads added as comments
steps: 1) Triage: Confirm symptoms (unable to login / 403 on admin routes / missing console features). Collect: username, organization id, error message, timestamp.
2) Check IdP health: verify the IdP metadata endpoint returns 200 and expected EntityID. Example: curl -fsS 'https://idp.example.com/metadata' | xmllint --format -

3) Validate SAML response shape: enable SAML debug logs (temporary) and ask customer to reproduce while capture is on. Use our proxy capture: curl -X POST https://console.redwood/instrumentation/saml-capture -d '{"user":"<email>"}'

4) Audit logs: run the activity query for role changes within timeframe. Example ClickHouse query: SELECT timestamp, actor_email, action, details FROM audit_logs WHERE org_id = '<org>' AND action LIKE '%role%' AND timestamp BETWEEN '<start>' AND '<end>' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
5) RBAC mapping: verify principle-to-role mapping using internal API: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' https://api.redwood/internal/orgs/<org>/principals/<user>/roles

6) Temporary admin grant: If customer needs immediate access, create timeboxed emergency role with note and add to audit: POST to /admin/roles with expires_at, then document the reason and notify Security

7) Root cause options: mis-mapped groups from IdP, stale role cache, missing attribute mapping (e.g., 'groups' vs 'memberOf'), or a regression in role resolution service. Document fix and follow-up ticket for permanent remediation.
8) Postmortem and revoke: ensure emergency role is revoked and add callbacks to quality monitoring dashboard to prevent recurrence
support_macros: macro:RBAC-V2-403_TEMPLATE -- Use for customers seeing 403 on admin routes: Hi {{customer_name}}, thanks for the report. We see a 403 on {{timestamp}} for {{user_email}}. First step: can you confirm you are using SSO via {{idp_name}}? We'll check role mapping and audit logs and follow up in ~30m. If urgent, request temporary admin with reason and duration.

macro:SSO-SAML-METADATA_CHECK -- Use to ask customer to validate IdP metadata: Please confirm your IdP metadata URL responds with HTTP 200 and contains EntityDescriptor entityID '{{expected_entity}}'. If possible, paste the <EntityDescriptor> element or attach the metadata XML.

macro:EMERGENCY_ADMIN_GRANT -- Use after approval from Security: Temporary admin granted until {{expires_at}} for reason: {{reason}}. Action taken by {{actor}}. Audit reference: {{audit_id}}. Please perform required actions and confirm when complete so we can revoke.
troubleshooting_snippets: Check SAML response for NameID and attributes: samltool validate --input response.xml | grep -E 'NameID|Attribute'
Curl metadata and check entityID: curl -fsS 'https://idp.example.com/metadata' | xmllint --xpath 'string(/EntityDescriptor/@entityID)' -
Inspect recent role change events (example using our internal API): curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 'https://internal.redwood/api/v1/audit?org=<org>&action=role:update&limit=50' | jq '.'
Validate cached role version on serving nodes: ssh admin@node-1 'redis-cli HGET role_cache:<org> version'
Force role cache refresh: curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 'https://internal.redwood/admin/role-cache/refresh?org=<org>'
